verses.text: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.

xrefs.text: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.

verses.text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

xrefs.text: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

verses.text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

xrefs.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!

At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.

verses.text: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

xrefs.text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

xrefs.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.

verses.text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

xrefs.text: In response, King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz cried out to heaven in prayer,
Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Concerning Benjamin he said: “May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.”
Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

verses.text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.

xrefs.text: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
What more can David say to You? For You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.
Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.

verses.text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

xrefs.text: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
The Philistines gathered together and camped at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa.
Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, took Saul’s son Ish-bosheth, moved him to Mahanaim,

The other half of Manasseh, along with the Reubenites and Gadites, had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them:

verses.text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

xrefs.text: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

Now in former times in Israel, concerning the redemption or exchange of property, to make any matter legally binding a man would remove his sandal and give it to the other party, and this was a confirmation in Israel.
“Never shall You wash my feet! Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.
Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken. For a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent from its egg.
Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.

verses.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

xrefs.text: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah with crimson-stained garments? Who is this robed in splendor, marching in the greatness of His strength? “It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”
The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction. When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
Concerning Edom, this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

verses.text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

xrefs.text: Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”
But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.

And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.
Your servant has killed lions and bears; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, for he has defied the armies of the living God.”
Now the Philistines brought all their forces together at Aphek, while Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.

verses.text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.
Put no more trust in man, who has only the breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?
All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.

verses.text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

xrefs.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

“I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.
For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
